finding: SBWOA outperformed four compared algorithms on 11 test problems built from real Alibaba Cloud order data.

method: MDP, neural approximate dynamic programming, deep Q-network
finding: Joint NeurADP+DDQN policy saves up to 6.7% over fixed pricing and about 18% over myopic baselines.

problem: vehicle routing for connected service areas

problem: truck-drone delivery routing with multiple delivery modes

problem: instant delivery order scheduling and routing
